project.new.empty_text: The initial text cannot be empty

project.delete.current: You cannot delete the project that is open

doc.truncated.title: {total} characters in total; only the first {n} are shown to keep scrolling smooth

doc.preview.nothing: There is no newer version than this one
rail.history.hint: Click any version to view it read-only.

run.no_args: This processor takes no parameters. Just run it.

manual.unchanged: Nothing changed, so no new version was created

processors.title: Processors
processors.subtitle: Every piece of processing logic is a small script. Write one yourself, or let an AI write it.
processors.empty.title: No processors yet
processors.empty.desc: Write one, or let an AI write one for you.
processors.pick.title: Pick a processor
processors.pick.desc: Choose one on the left to read or edit its source, or create a new one.
processors.delete.title: Delete processor
processors.delete.text: "{name}" will be deleted. Versions it already produced are not affected.
processors.confirm.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
ai.title: Write a processor with AI
ai.request.placeholder: e.g. Pull out every line that starts with a chapter heading and put a blank line before it
ai.copied: Prompt copied. Paste it into any AI chat.
ai.copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the prompt and copy it manually.
ai.need_request: Describe the effect you want first
ai.paste.placeholder: Paste the code the AI returned here
ai.hint: The prompt already contains the full interface description, so the AI never needs to see this program's code.
ai.preview.title: Prompt to be copied
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.single: Only one interface language is available.
settings.wrap.desc: When off, lines do not wrap and line numbers are shown.
settings.font.desc: Affects the preview only; the text itself is unchanged.
settings.display.desc: Only the first N characters are shown, which keeps long texts responsive. Processing always uses the full text.
settings.log_level.desc: How much is recorded. DEBUG writes every ignored detail; turn it on only while troubleshooting.
settings.log_cleanup.desc: Deletes log files older than the retention period at startup; turn it off to keep them all.
settings.log_days.desc: How long logs are kept, 30 days by default. Has no effect while the switch above is off.
settings.data.change.title: Change data directory
settings.data.change.hint: A text-processor folder is appended automatically. Data moves on the next start.
settings.data.same: That is already the current directory
settings.data.nested: The new directory cannot be nested inside the current one
settings.data.pending: Saved. Data will move to {path} on the next start.
settings.data.restart.title: Data directory saved
settings.data.restart.text: Existing data will be moved to the new location after a restart. Restart now?
settings.data.recycle.desc: Deleted projects go here and can be recovered by hand.
settings.manual.desc: Come back to it any time.
settings.reset.desc: Resets appearance, interface options and log settings only. Projects and processors are untouched.
close.title: Unsaved changes
close.text: Closing the window will discard them.
error.preview: The text cannot be changed while previewing
